description: Source code for an invoice payment wizard in an OpenERP/Odoo module, handling payment form display, currency conversions, reconciliation, and write-off logic.

classes.name: wizard_pay_invoice
classes.description: Wizard interface class for paying invoices, managing states for payment, reconciliation, and write-off.

methods.name: _pay_and_reconcile
methods.description: Handles the payment and reconciliation process, including currency conversion and context updates.

methods.name: _wo_check
methods.description: Checks if a write-off is needed based on currency differences and invoice amounts.

methods.name: _get_value_addendum
methods.description: Provides default value for write-off comment.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Determines the accounting period for the invoice, raising an error if invoice is in draft, proforma, or canceled state.
